answer: Propose one vote/day per ID storing 1 GiB of ledge and spiral-stair inspection video from dawn to dawn. Validators assign disjoint client-encrypted shards and check random block replies against client commitments; missing, late or invalid replies deny the vote. Disks are reusable capital; power and audit traffic recur, with no stake. Client collusion or cheap reconstruction defeats the storage cost; spot checks can miss deletion. This meters capacity, not owners. Ten compliant IDs retain 10 GiB concurrently; pooled disks and parallel agents cannot credit bytes twice.
